summary: Fix TOCTOU vulnerability in load() method by using os.open() + os.fstat() + os.read() on a single file descriptor instead of separate stat() and read_text() calls

security_fix.attack_vector: Attacker could swap file between stat() and read_text() to bypass size limit
security_fix.fix_approach: Use single file descriptor for both stat and read operations
security_fix.implementation: os.open() + os.fstat() + os.read() on same fd

risks: Minor performance impact due to low-level os calls instead of pathlib
